examples.romanization: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, tā xīnli yǒu le yí ge xīn de niàntou.
examples.translation: After hearing this news, a new idea came into his mind.
examples.translation_en: After hearing this news, a new idea came into his mind.
examples.translation_id: Setelah mendengar berita ini, sebuah ide baru muncul di benaknya.

translation_en: side, aspect, surface

examples.text: 请把证件有照片的一面朝上放在桌上。
examples.textVariant: 請把證件有照片的一面朝上放在桌上。
examples.romanization: Qǐng bǎ zhèngjiàn yǒu zhàopiàn de yí miàn cháo shàng fàng zài zhuō shàng.
examples.translation: Please place the side of the document with the photo facing upwards on the table.
examples.translation_en: Please place the side of the document with the photo facing upwards on the table.
examples.translation_id: Silakan letakkan sisi dokumen dengan foto menghadap ke atas di atas meja.

examples.text: 我们不能只看问题的一面，还要考虑整体情况。
examples.textVariant: 我們不能只看問題的一面，還要考慮整體情況。
examples.romanization: Wǒmen bù néng zhǐ kàn wèntí de yí miàn, hái yào kǎolǜ zhěngtǐ qíngkuàng.
examples.translation: We cannot look at only one side of the problem; we also need to consider the overall situation.
examples.translation_en: We cannot look at only one side of the problem; we also need to consider the overall situation.
examples.translation_id: Kita tidak bisa hanya melihat satu sisi dari masalah ini; kita juga perlu mempertimbangkan situasi secara keseluruhan.

examples.text: 这面墙需要重新粉刷，否则会影响房间的整体效果。
examples.textVariant: 這面牆需要重新粉刷，否則會影響房間的整體效果。
examples.romanization: Zhè miàn qiáng xūyào chóngxīn fěnshuā, fǒuzé huì yǐngxiǎng fángjiān de zhěngtǐ xiàoguǒ.
examples.translation: This wall needs repainting; otherwise it will affect the overall effect of the room.
examples.translation_en: This wall needs repainting; otherwise it will affect the overall effect of the room.
examples.translation_id: Tembok ini perlu dicat ulang; jika tidak maka akan mempengaruhi efek ruangan secara keseluruhan.
